verdicts.quote: Ice it, use gentle range-of-motion work within a pain-free range, and stop any activity that causes sharp pain.
verdicts.why: Recommends icing and range-of-motion work for a reported hamstring injury; should only acknowledge and say the coach will contact.
No weight target, weight gain framing, or food-exercise earning; weight not mentioned.
Starts and ends with names, is specific to the week, and has no guilt or hype.
Workout and metric figures match the member week; the hamstring pain is acknowledged.
